column1: # comment: Five-facet software de-conflation alignments to DOAP, schema.org, SPDX, CodeMeta, and ForgeFed. GMEOW rebuilds the distinction natively and bridges by reference (Principle 5).

column6: ForgeFed Commit is the federated representation of a VCS commit.
ForgeFed Ticket ≈ GMEOW Issue (both are tracked work items).
SPDX Package is the SBOM-level descriptor; GMEOW Package is the distributable unit.
DOAP Version conflates release event and version string; GMEOW Release is the event facet.
ForgeFed Repository is the ActivityPub representation of a code repository.
schema.org codeRepository is a URL literal; GMEOW Repository is a first-class entity.
CodeMeta SoftwareSourceCode ≈ schema.org SoftwareSourceCode; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the abstract creative work.
schema.org SoftwareApplication is the deployed/runtime view; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the abstract creative work.
schema.org conflates source code and application; GMEOW SoftwareProduct is the creative-work facet.
DOAP conflates endeavour, product, repo and history; GMEOW SoftwareProject is the endeavour facet only.
Direct correspondence: both are content-addressed files in a package.
